review.summary: The three shelf levels and base are retained, but the generated rear has a large protruding oval plate absent from the reference construction. The shelf brackets also become string-like strands instead of compact solid supports. Retry shape within the saved budget.

issues.problem: Large invented protruding oval plate changes the freestanding shelf silhouette and back construction.
Thin string-like bracket geometry replaces the reference solid support brackets.

review.summary: All five actual GLB views show the shelf collapsed into thin radiating strands rather than solid shelves/back/base. Read-only numeric inspection confirms finite coordinates in a normal-sized bounding box, so this is malformed mesh output rather than a distant outlier distorting the camera. Use the third and final permitted AI shape attempt.

issues.problem: Solid shelf geometry collapsed into radiating strips; no usable shelf assembly remains.

review.summary: The 14524-triangle shelf preserves three levels, open compartments, solid supports, plain back panel and the three material regions. Finished front/opposite views and rear PBR stay close to the approved source. Fresh FBX and GLB checks pass.

issues.problem: Neutral-only faceting and modest edge softening after reduction; source plinth irregularity remains minor in the finished timber material.

review.summary: Warm ochre front panel, cream shelf surfaces and dark timber plinth are cleanly separated. The plain rear is consistently covered and no invented labels, oval plate or strand-like supports have returned. Front/opposite views retain the reference shelf appearance.

issues.problem: Rear panel is a paler inferred finish than the ochre front.

review.summary: Third candidate resolves the large invented rear oval and collapsed geometry. A plain back panel, three shelf levels including the base, open shelf spaces and solid support brackets are present. The front is visible in the opposite/front views because this candidate is rotated relative to the earlier one.

issues.problem: Small surface irregularity along the lower plinth remains.
Support brackets are squarer and simpler than the reference.
